title: Grade 2 Math — Fri, Jun 20
description: Time — Day 5 of 5: Mixed review — reading clock, AM/PM, duration
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Read the clock: hour hand on 9, minute hand on 12. The time is ___.
questions.explanation: Hour hand on 9, minute hand on 12 = 9 o'clock = 9:00.

questions.question: Read the clock: hour hand between 1 and 2, minute hand on 6. The time is ___.
questions.explanation: Hour hand between 1 and 2, minute hand on 6 = half past 1 = 1:30.

questions.question: Read the clock: hour hand on 5, minute hand on 3. The time is ___.
questions.explanation: Minute hand on 3 = 15 minutes = quarter past. Hour hand on 5 = 5:15.

questions.question: Read the clock: hour hand near 7, minute hand on 9. The time is ___.
questions.explanation: Minute hand on 9 = 45 minutes = quarter to next hour. Hour hand near 7 = 7:45 (quarter to 8).

questions.question: Arrange in order (earliest to latest): 7:45 AM · 7:15 AM · 8:00 AM · 7:30 AM
questions.explanation: 7:15 AM → 7:30 AM → 7:45 AM → 8:00 AM (earliest to latest).

questions.question: A football match is 1 hour 30 minutes long. It starts at 4:00 PM. It ends at ___.
questions.explanation: 4:00 PM + 1 hour = 5:00 PM. 5:00 PM + 30 minutes = 5:30 PM.

questions.question: School lunch is from 12:30 PM to 1:00 PM. How long is lunch?
Is 11:59 an AM or PM time?
questions.explanation: 11:59 is AM if it is morning (just before noon) or PM if it is night (just before midnight). We need to know which one.

questions.question: Neha practices piano from 5:15 PM to 5:45 PM. How long does she practice?
How many minutes are in 2 hours?
Ravi's class starts at 9:00 AM and his recess is at 10:30 AM. How long does he study before recess?
The minute hand is on 8. How many minutes past the hour is it?
Sana slept 9 hours. She woke up at 7:00 AM. What time did she go to sleep?
